name: Malaysian Cinnamon
desc: Malaysian Cinnamon (Cinnamomum burmanni): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cinnamomum burmanni, also known as Indonesian cinnamon, Padang cassia, Batavia cassia, or korintje, is one of several plants in the genus Cinnamomum whose bark is sold as the spice cinnamon.
